feed.subtitle: Fourth-year Software Engineering student at Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Joining the BIRTH Lab, School of Biomedical Engineering, Tsinghua University, as a PhD student in Fall 2027, advised by Qiyuan Tian. Research spans biomedical imaging and image processing, AI drug discovery, multi-agent systems, and graph neural networks, with interest in model security.
